covers.title: Cover Heat Control
covers.description: Close a cover automatically when it's too hot. Once closed, it stays closed for the rest of the day — only the next day's normal open, or the daily schedule's own evening close, touch it again. The active window is entirely derived from Daily Cover Schedule's computed open/close times — configure that first.

data_description.cover_entities: Select the cover entities to control when it is too hot.
data_description.cover_temp_threshold: Temperature above which the selected action is triggered.
data_description.cover_action: 'Close' sends the standard close_cover command. 'Stop' sends stop_cover, halting movement mid-travel — useful for Somfy RTS covers (the My/favorite position is a separate button entity).
data_description.cover_my_button: Button to press to send covers to their favorite (My) position. If set, this button is used instead of the action below.
data_description.cover_weather_entity: Optional weather entity with daily forecasts. When set, the cover closes proactively at the day's cover open time if today's forecast high exceeds the forecast threshold, instead of waiting for the outdoor sensor to actually cross it.
data_description.cover_forecast_threshold: Forecast daily high above which the proactive close triggers.

daily_cover_schedule.title: Daily Cover Schedule
daily_cover_schedule.description: Natively open and close a cover group every day, without a separate Scheduler-integration entity. Kept separate from Cover Heat Control, which targets a single cover. For each day mode below, set 'sunrise', 'skip', or a custom 'HH:MM' opening time — modes sharing the same value form a batch. Closing always happens once per day, for every mode, at sunset + the offset below.

data_description.daily_cover_entities: Cover entities (e.g. a cover group) to open and close on the daily schedule below.
data_description.sunrise_earliest: The sunrise-based opening time will be the later of actual sunrise and this value.
data_description.daily_cover_close_offset_minutes: Covers close this many minutes after sunset, every day, regardless of day mode.
data_description.daily_open_time_home: Opening time for the Home day mode: 'sunrise', 'skip', or a custom 'HH:MM' value.
data_description.daily_open_time_work: Opening time for the Work day mode: 'sunrise', 'skip', or a custom 'HH:MM' value.
data_description.daily_open_time_remote: Opening time for the Remote day mode: 'sunrise', 'skip', or a custom 'HH:MM' value.
data_description.daily_open_time_away: Opening time for the Away day mode: 'sunrise', 'skip', or a custom 'HH:MM' value.
